```{julia}
task_cols = names(event_log, r"^task_")
K = length(task_cols)
eps = 1e-12
logK = log(K)

H = Vector{Float64}(undef, nrow(event_log))

@inbounds for (i, r) in enumerate(eachrow(event_log))
    s = 0.0
    # sum
    for c in task_cols
        v = r[c]
        s += v + eps
    end
    # entropy
    h = 0.0
    invs = 1.0 / s
    for c in task_cols
        p = (r[c] + eps) * invs
        h -= p * log(p)
    end
    H[i] = h / logK   # normalized to [0,1]
end

event_log.entropy = H
```

```{julia}
axpos = (1,1)
labelsize = 22
ticklabelsize = 20
acc_evofig = Makie.Figure(size = (800, 600))
ax = Makie.Axis(acc_evofig[axpos[1], axpos[2]], 
        xlabel = L"\text{Simulation Time}", 
        ylabel = L"\text{Accuracy Entropy per Agent}",
        #title = "Evolution of Accuracy of the best performing agent per task",
        xlabelsize = labelsize,
        ylabelsize = labelsize,
        xticklabelsize = ticklabelsize,
        yticklabelsize = ticklabelsize,
        )
ax.xticks = Makie.LinearTicks(7)
agent_ids = unique(event_log.bee1_id)
for id in agent_ids
    bee_log = filter(row -> row.bee1_id == id, event_log)
    Makie.lines!(bee_log.time, bee_log.entropy)
end
```
